roof_top_exposure.basis: frozen legal floor roles; top changes roof boundary while middle remains adiabatic

thermal_mass.basis: engineering sensitivity around each actual prototype reference; InternalMass thickness changes while envelope U-values remain fixed

nominal_cooling_capacity.basis: engineering sensitivity around each actual 145/150/155/160 W m-2 reference; COP is unchanged

AC_operating_time.basis: one-hour earlier/later AC availability; weather, outage clock, occupancy, lights and plugs unchanged

scientific_identity: controlled model sensitivity, not an empirically calibrated intervention effect
